Gold and Silver Prices Plummet, Affecting Market Sentiment

Gold and silver prices have seen a significant decline, with silver dropping substantially from its record high. One report indicates silver has become cheaper by ₹13,000 per kilogram in a week and is down ₹2.42 lakh per kilogram from its peak. This sharp fall in prices is reportedly causing concern and potentially disrupting market dynamics.
